instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Ali Fahim Ni'ma
subject: 04_Advanced_Software_Eng

questions.question: How is Risk Exposure computed?
questions.explanation: Risk Exposure multiplies the probability of the event by the size of the loss.
questions.explanation_ar: التعرّض للخطر يضرب احتمال الحدث في حجم الخسارة.

questions.question: Risk management activities are divided into...
questions.explanation: Risk management splits into risk assessment and risk control, so two categories.
questions.explanation_ar: إدارة المخاطر تنقسم إلى تقييم المخاطر وضبط المخاطر، أي فئتان.

questions.question: Which one is NOT a risk management activity?
questions.question_ar: أي واحد ليس نشاطاً من أنشطة إدارة المخاطر؟
questions.explanation: Assessment and control are the two activities; nobody generates risk on purpose.
questions.explanation_ar: التقييم والضبط هما النشاطان، ولا أحد يولّد المخاطر عمداً.

questions.question: Cost estimation for a project may include...
questions.explanation: A full project estimate covers software, hardware and personnel together.
questions.explanation_ar: التقدير الكامل للمشروع يغطي البرمجيات والعتاد والأفراد معاً.

questions.question: Which one is NOT infrastructure software?
questions.question_ar: أي واحد ليس برمجيات بنية تحتية؟
questions.explanation: Infrastructure means operating systems, DBMS and compilers, not an application result system.
questions.explanation_ar: البنية التحتية تعني أنظمة التشغيل وقواعد البيانات والمترجمات، لا نظام نتائج تطبيقي.

questions.question: What does risk assessment cover?
options: paying the insurance now again too
writing the code here too here
options_en: paying the insurance now again too
writing the code here too here
questions.explanation: Assessment establishes what the risks are and how serious each one is.
questions.explanation_ar: التقييم يحدد ما هي المخاطر ومدى خطورة كل واحدة.

questions.question: What does risk control cover?
options: identifying the risks only again too
estimating the size here too now
options_en: identifying the risks only again too
estimating the size here too now
questions.explanation: Control turns the assessment into a plan and tracks whether it works.
questions.explanation_ar: الضبط يحوّل التقييم إلى خطة ويتابع نجاحها.

questions.question: Why is early risk identification valuable?
questions.question_ar: لماذا تحديد المخاطر مبكراً ذو قيمة؟
options: it removes all uncertainty here again here
it shortens the code now too now here
it raises the price here again too
options_en: it removes all uncertainty here again here
it shortens the code now too now here
it raises the price here again too
questions.explanation: A risk found during planning can still be designed around; one found late cannot.
questions.explanation_ar: الخطر المكتشف في التخطيط يمكن التصميم حوله، والمتأخر لا يمكن.
